deviations.source_anchor: The kit's signature is an UNBOUNDED cascading kill-chain (each explosion-kill triggers the next explosion across the whole pack). Engine MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 is LOCKED, so the map expresses a single on-kill->burst step via GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade — the chain-reaction is truncated to one hop, never minted deeper per charter law. A player of the original would notice the screen-wide auto-chain becomes a bounded single-propagation; the 'zero-input movement clears everything' identity is intact but its unlimited-cascade magnitude is capped.

mapping.deviation_notes: The kit's signature is an UNBOUNDED cascading kill-chain (each explosion-kill triggers the next explosion across the whole pack). Engine MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 is LOCKED, so the map expresses a single on-kill->burst step via GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade — the chain-reaction is truncated to one hop, never minted deeper per charter law. A player of the original would notice the screen-wide auto-chain becomes a bounded single-propagation; the 'zero-input movement clears everything' identity is intact but its unlimited-cascade magnitude is capped.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: ON-KILL PROPAGATION: GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade (on-kill) is the exact T4 door. The kit is dual-element: cold (Herald of Ice shatter) + lightning (Inpulsa explosion). Ailments: freeze (Shield Charge crit-freeze, native shatter payoff) + shock->sunder (Inpulsa requires SHOCKED enemies; PoE shock = engine sunder, false-friend). CHAIN-DEPTH VIOLATION: the source is a CASCADING kill-chain — kill -> explode -> that explosion kills -> which explodes -> ... unbounded hops across the pack. Engine MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 is LOCKED; the map expresses ONE on-kill -> burst-damage step (trigger_chain_shape=apply-consume-pair at depth 1). The unbounded cascade is truncated to single-step propagation — NOT minted deeper (charter law). §7.2 dominant-loop: the player's active 3-sec input is MOVEMENT (dash_attack); explosions are autonomous, so movement geometry leads. A player of the original would keep the 'run and everything detonates' feel but the engine models it as bounded single-hop on-kill propagation rather than screen-wide unbounded chain-reaction.

spine.mech_note: Herald of Ice shatters enemies it kills with cold damage, and Inpulsa's Broken Heart unique chest makes those shatters EXPLODE nearby enemies — a chain reaction requiring zero active button presses. The player runs through a pack, the lead kill chains into a screen-clearing explosion. The active skill is often Cyclone or any rapid-hit cold skill to trigger the first kill; Herald of Ice handles the rest autonomously. CWDT (Cast when Damage Taken) setups add free defensive spells. The identity: movement IS the skill expression — the player navigates efficiently, the explosions clear automatically. Popularized in Breach league (3.0) and dominant as a map-clear archetype for years before Inpulsa nerfs tightened the chain-reaction radius. Represents PoE1's 'movement-as-gameplay' archetype at its most complete.
